package storage

func fixedRunTime(seconds int64) func() int64 { return func() int64 { return seconds } }

const sampleSpec = `apiVersion: guardrail.open/v1alpha1
kind: GuardrailSpec
metadata:
  name: recovery
spec:
  description: Check recovery readiness
  instructions: Inspect current state and provide evidence
  validForSeconds: 900
  checks:
    - id: readiness
      displayName: Recovery readiness
      description: Check recovery readiness
      instructions: Inspect current health and provide evidence
      criteria:
        pass: Health is good
        block: Health is bad
        unknown: Health is not verified
      evidenceRequirements:
        - id: health
          description: Record current health
          appliesToVerdicts: [PASS, BLOCKED, UNKNOWN]
`

name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: guardrail_test
          POSTGRES_USER: guardrail
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [REDACTED]
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U guardrail -d guardrail_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://guardrail:disposable-ci-only@localhost:5432/guardrail_test?sslmode=disable
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: make test
      - run: make build
      - run: CLEANUP_DEMO_BINARIES="$PWD/bin" python3 -m unittest discover -s examples/cleanup-demo -p 'test_*.py' -v
      - run: make smoke
      - run: go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.8.0 ./...
  fuzz:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true
      - run: make test-fuzz
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: fuzz-regressions
          path: |
            internal/domain/spec/testdata/fuzz/
            internal/domain/run/testdata/fuzz/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
  demo-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
      - run: make test-python
      - run: make build
      - run: CLEANUP_DEMO_BINARIES="$PWD/bin" python3 -m unittest discover -s examples/cleanup-demo -p 'test_*.py' -v
      - run: make smoke
  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: make smoke-release VERSION=0.1.0-alpha.0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: binaries
          path: dist/*.tar.gz*
  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - run: make smoke-docker

# Run from the repository root: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml ...
services:
  guardrail:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile
    environment:
      OPEN_GUARDRAIL_PUBLIC_URL: ${OPEN_GUARDRAIL_PUBLIC_URL:?Set the external HTTPS origin, without a trailing slash}
    volumes:
      - guardrail-data:/data
    networks:
      - backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No host port: plaintext HTTP is reachable only on this private network.
  proxy:
    image: nginx:stable-alpine
    ports:
      - "${OPEN_GUARDRAIL_HTTPS_BIND:-127.0.0.1:8443}:443"
    volumes:
      - ./nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ${OPEN_GUARDRAIL_TLS_DIR:?Set an absolute directory containing fullchain.pem and privkey.pem}
        target: /etc/nginx/tls
        read_only: true
        bind:
          create_host_path: false
    networks:
      - edge
      - backend
    depends_on:
      - guardrail
    restart: unless-stopped
networks:
  edge:
  backend:
    internal: true
volumes:
  guardrail-data:

# GitHub Actions deployment integration

Status: planned. There is no reusable workflow or Action implementation yet.

Deployment jobs will call the shared guardrail CLI or HTTP API before deployment
and, where a workflow exposes batches, before the next batch continues. Keep build
and deployment execution in the workflow; the shared core accepts evidence and
returns the authoritative check result.

Correlate the change with the workflow run and attempt. Reuse `--operation-id`
only when retrying the same Run-creation or evidence-submission request.
Run APIs and the shared CLI are already available;
the adopter-facing workflow is the planned work. Its implementation must define
credential handling, wait/timeout behavior and blocked/unknown outcomes using
those existing contracts. Start with [Runs and submissions](../../docs/runs.md)
and the [CLI guide](../../cmd/guardrailctl/README.md).

Keep this deployment recipe in `integrations/github-actions`. The repository's own
`.github/workflows` contains development checks and build automation. A platform
that calls the shared CLI/API needs no separate guardrail binary or core fork.

# External permission facts

Status: planned. This directory does not yet define a Go interface.

Expose the enterprise role or permission facts required for a verified actor,
resource, operation and scope. The contract must use public types and define
denial, provider unavailability and cancellation behavior.

The application combines those facts with authoritative guardrail state, such as
resource ownership, the selected Spec and Run participation. Enterprise role
lookup must not replace these checks, change a verdict or write business state.

Keep local credentials and external directory objects out of the contract.
Validate the first interface with both the built-in authorization path and a
synthetic provider. See [core authorization](../../internal/application/authorization/README.md).

# Guardrail authorization use cases

Status: planned. Current management handlers still enforce the local administrator
role directly; this directory does not yet provide a replacement service.

Own authorization for guardrail resources and operations. Combine a verified actor
and external permission facts with authoritative Spec/Run ownership, scope and
participation. Business-state checks stay in the shared application.

An enterprise provider supplies organizational facts, not a replacement for Run
validity or evidence acceptance. Provider errors do not imply permission. Keep
authentication, external role lookup and core resource checks separate so an adopter
can replace identity without copying management handlers.

# Recovery Agent demo

Start with [Getting started](../../docs/getting-started.md) if you need a local
service, administrator account or CLI session. The
[documentation index](../../docs/README.md) links the full set of guides.

This demo lets an Agent evaluate three synthetic health observations against the
published Recovery Spec. The observation files contain no verdicts or prepared
Submissions. The Agent creates three independent Runs and supplies its own Check
summaries and Evidence; the server produces the final Decisions.

## Try it with Codex

This is the **first-time, no-Jenkins path**: one local service, one CLI login,
then one instruction to the Agent. Jenkins, public-key encryption and a
deployment pipeline are not involved.

Start the local service and make `guardrailctl` available (from a release archive
or by building this repository). Initialize the administrator if this is a new
service. Sign in to the CLI once with `guardrailctl auth login --username <name>`;
the password is entered through its hidden prompt. The browser session does not
authenticate the CLI. Then ask Codex, from the checkout or extracted release:

> Use `$open-guardrail-demo` to evaluate all three observations in
> `examples/agent-demo/`. Create and submit three Runs, show me their Run IDs and
> Decisions, and check that I can inspect them on the Runs page.

The Agent uses `guardrailctl scene apply`, `auth create-key`, `run create`,
`run submit`, and `run get`. It writes private credentials and working JSON
outside the repository. Expect `PASS / ALLOW` for the healthy case,
`BLOCKED / DENY` for the unhealthy case, and `UNKNOWN / DENY` when the probe
times out. Open the local management page and select **Runs** to inspect the
three immutable records. A Guardrail Decision does
not itself pause or resume a release; the integrating business system chooses
whether to enforce it.

The service address defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. For another local
address, set `OPEN_GUARDRAIL_URL` to the exact origin before signing in and
running the demo. The files in this directory contain synthetic observations
only; no real service is queried.

## Jenkins pipeline example

See [the advanced Jenkins + outer Agent example](../../integrations/jenkins/README.md).
There the Agent triggers Jenkins and submits directly with its encrypted Run
token handoff, while Jenkins independently waits for the Decision. Jenkins does
not run Codex. The local `smoke.py` exercises the actual API/CLI and management
list with deterministic synthetic checks; it does **not** evaluate model quality.
Run it with `python3 examples/agent-demo/smoke.py` if you want an isolated
technical self-check without touching your existing service.


## Isolated technical self-check

For a guided local trial that keeps all four synthetic Runs available in the
browser, use:

```sh
python3 examples/agent-demo/smoke.py --keep-running
```

Choose the temporary administrator password at the hidden prompts. After the
checks pass, open the printed URL, sign in as `demo` and select **Runs**.
Ctrl-C stops the service and removes its temporary data and credentials.
The source-only `make demo` target starts the separate
[file cleanup example](../cleanup-demo/README.md). See
[troubleshooting](../../docs/getting-started.md#troubleshooting) for dependency,
startup and login issues.

From either the source checkout or an extracted native release, run:

```sh
python3 examples/agent-demo/smoke.py
```

Python 3.9+ is needed for this optional self-check. In a source checkout it builds
the server and CLI with Go; in a release it uses the two packaged binaries and
needs no Go or Node.js. It starts its own loopback service, uses a temporary data
and credential directory, and leaves an existing service untouched. It verifies
healthy ALLOW, unhealthy DENY, unknown DENY, and a stored ALLOW whose forged
Evidence must still be blocked by the delivery gate. These are deterministic
contract checks and do not measure an Agent's reasoning quality.

The optional `--password-stdin` flag reads the temporary administrator password
from stdin for automated `--keep-running` trials. No password is accepted as a
command-line argument.

Release maintainers use `make smoke-release VERSION=...` to run this from the
actual archive with an empty executable search path. See
[release verification](../../docs/releases.md).

# Shared Recovery Agent gate

This is the shared implementation reference for the synthetic
[Jenkins](../jenkins/README.md) and [Argo Rollouts](../argo/README.md) demos.
For a first local trial, use [Getting started](../../docs/getting-started.md)
or the [local Agent demo](../../examples/agent-demo/README.md).

`gate.py` is the pipeline-neutral part of the advanced demo. A delivery adapter
supplies one `GateInput` with an immutable `change_set`, stable
`operation_identity`, observation and Project Key file path. Prepare uses the
Project Key to create a Run and fetch its immutable PolicyRevision through the
Run-scoped reader, then encrypts the Submission Credential, Spec and observation
for the **outer Agent**. The Agent submits directly with that credential, without
the Project Key. The delivery adapter polls the authoritative Decision and permits
continuation only for a `FINISHED`, unexpired `PASS / ALLOW`.
The gate does not deploy, resume, or invoke a model on the worker.

Adapters include [Jenkins](../jenkins/README.md) and
[Argo Rollouts](../argo/README.md). Another CD system can map
its own build identity, checkpoint, observation source and credential injection
to the same `GateInput`; it must not add its own Decision aggregation or bypass the
authoritative Run query. Keep platform API clients and environment-variable names
in that adapter. This shared gate is **Recovery-demo-specific** (`readiness` Check,
`health` Evidence), not a general policy engine or a new server-side provider API.

The operation identity is hashed into stable create/submit idempotency keys. An
uncertain create/submit result is never retried with a new identity. Inspect the
Run and follow [credential recovery](../../docs/runs.md) before any retry.

`guardrailctl run revision` reads only the Revision pinned to that Run.
`guardrailctl run submission --submission-id <id>` reads a stored Snapshot within
that Run. Both require the Project Key; a Submission Credential grants neither reader.
The final gate verifies the stored Snapshot identity, verdict and health Evidence.

The final release condition combines a current authoritative ALLOW with the
business adapter's evidence rule. The Recovery demo uses exact structured health
equality; other business adapters can define their own bounded evidence checks.
`GateStopped` retains RuntimeError compatibility and exposes a fixed failure
layer/reason to adapters. Argo records these in logs and the Pod termination
message; it never prints raw error bodies or credentials.

"""Regression checks for local demo credential handling and lifecycle."""

import contextlib
import importlib.util
import io
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch


spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("agent_demo_smoke", Path(__file__).with_name("smoke.py"))
demo = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(demo)


class DemoLifecycleTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unsupported_python_stops_before_building_or_starting_a_service(self):
        error = io.StringIO()
        with patch.object(demo.sys, "version_info", (3, 8)), patch.object(
            demo.subprocess, "run"
        ) as run, patch.object(demo.subprocess, "Popen") as start, contextlib.redirect_stderr(error):
            with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as stopped:
                demo.main([])
        self.assertEqual(stopped.exception.code, 2)
        self.assertIn("Python 3.9+", error.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("manual walkthrough", error.getvalue())
        run.assert_not_called()
        start.assert_not_called()

    def test_inspection_password_uses_hidden_prompts_and_is_not_printed(self):
        args = demo.options(["--keep-running"])
        password = "[REDACTED]"
        output = io.StringIO()
        with patch.object(demo.sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=True), patch.object(
            demo.getpass, "getpass", side_effect=[password, password]
        ) as prompt, contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), contextlib.redirect_stderr(output):
            self.assertEqual(demo.administrator_password(args), password)
        self.assertEqual(prompt.call_count, 2)
        self.assertNotIn(password, output.getvalue())

    def test_password_from_stdin_cannot_silently_be_ignored_by_automatic_smoke(self):
        error = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stderr(error), self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            demo.options(["--password-stdin"])
        self.assertIn("--password-stdin requires --keep-running", error.getvalue())

    def test_mismatched_password_stops_before_starting_a_service(self):
        with patch.object(demo.sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=True), patch.object(
            demo.getpass, "getpass", side_effect=["first-test-password", "other-test-password"]
        ), patch.object(demo.subprocess, "Popen") as start:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "passwords do not match"):
                demo.main(["--keep-running"])
        start.assert_not_called()

    def test_noninteractive_inspection_requires_explicit_stdin_mode(self):
        with patch.object(demo.sys.stdin, "isatty", return_value=False):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "--password-stdin"):
                demo.administrator_password(demo.options(["--keep-running"]))
        with patch.object(demo.sys, "stdin", io.StringIO("stdin-demo-test-only\n")):
            self.assertEqual(
                demo.administrator_password(demo.options(["--keep-running", "--password-stdin"])),
                "stdin-demo-test-only",
            )

    def test_readiness_failure_reports_exit_code_and_next_step(self):
        service = Mock()
        service.poll.return_value = -9
        service.returncode = -9
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, r"exit -9.*terminal"):
            demo.wait_for_service(service, "http://127.0.0.1:1")

    def test_inspection_waits_until_interrupt_without_printing_a_password(self):
        service = Mock()
        service.poll.return_value = None
        output = io.StringIO()
        with patch.object(demo.time, "sleep", side_effect=KeyboardInterrupt), contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
            demo.inspect_in_browser(service, "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
        self.assertIn("sign in as demo", output.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("Ctrl-C", output.getvalue())
        self.assertIn("remove its temporary data", output.getvalue())
        service.terminate.assert_not_called()

    def test_lost_service_does_not_report_successful_inspection(self):
        service = Mock()
        service.poll.return_value = 1
        service.returncode = 1
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()), self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "exit 1"):
            demo.inspect_in_browser(service, "http://127.0.0.1:8080")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Contract tests for the outer Agent client; no Jenkins or model is contacted."""

import json
from io import BytesIO
from urllib.error import HTTPError
import stat
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

from integrations.jenkins import agent_client
from integrations.recovery_agent import gate
from integrations.recovery_agent.test_gate import snapshot


class AgentClientTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_start_passes_only_public_key_and_case(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            work = Path(root) / "private"

            def fake_command(*args, **kwargs):
                if args[1] == "-o":
                    Path(args[2]).write_text("private-test-key")
                    return ""
                return "age1testrecipient\n"

            headers = {"Location": "https://jenkins.example/queue/item/42/"}
            with mock.patch.object(agent_client.gate, "command", side_effect=fake_command), \
                 mock.patch.object(agent_client, "jenkins_request",
                                   return_value=("https://jenkins.example/job/demo/buildWithParameters",
                                                 headers, b"")) as request:
                agent_client.start(SimpleNamespace(job_url="https://jenkins.example/job/demo",
                                                   case="healthy", work_dir=str(work)))
            self.assertIn(b"AGENT_AGE_RECIPIENT=age1testrecipient", request.call_args.kwargs["data"])
            self.assertNotIn(b"private-test-key", request.call_args.kwargs["data"])
            self.assertNotIn(b"GUARDRAIL_URL", request.call_args.kwargs["data"])
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE((work / "agent-identity.txt").stat().st_mode), 0o600)

    def test_start_requires_a_fresh_work_directory(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "fresh --work-dir"):
                agent_client.start(SimpleNamespace(job_url="https://jenkins.example/job/demo",
                                                   case="healthy", work_dir=root))

    def test_receive_and_submit_use_run_token_without_project_key(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            work = Path(root) / "private"
            work.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            gate.private_json(work / "state.json", {
                "jobUrl": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo",
                "queueUrl": "https://jenkins.example/queue/item/42/",
            })
            (work / "agent-identity.txt").write_text("test-only")
            observation = {"status": "healthy", "httpStatus": 200}
            bundle = {"runId": "run_test", "operationPrefix": "gate-test",
                      "baseSubmissionNo": 0, "policyRevisionId": "rev_test", "specDigest": "digest",
                      "specSnapshot": "kind: GuardrailSpec", "observation": observation,
                      "runToken": {"runId": "run_test", "token": "ogrt_test",
                                   "server": "https://guardrail.example"}}

            def fake_jenkins(url, **kwargs):
                if "/queue/item/" in url:
                    return url, {}, json.dumps({"executable": {
                        "url": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo/42/"}}).encode()
                return url, {}, b"ciphertext"

            def fake_command(*args, **kwargs):
                if args[0] == "age":
                    gate.private_json(Path(args[args.index("-o") + 1]), bundle)
                    return ""
                self.assertEqual(args[1:3], ("run", "submit"))
                self.assertNotIn("--key-file", args)
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["env"]["OPEN_GUARDRAIL_URL"], "https://guardrail.example")
                self.assertEqual(json.loads(Path(args[args.index("--submission-credential-file") + 1]).read_text()),
                                 bundle["runToken"])
                return "{}"

            with mock.patch.object(agent_client, "jenkins_request", side_effect=fake_jenkins), \
                 mock.patch.object(agent_client.gate, "command", side_effect=fake_command):
                agent_client.receive(SimpleNamespace(work_dir=str(work), timeout_seconds=10))
                submission = work / "submission.json"
                gate.private_json(submission, snapshot(observation))
                agent_client.submit(SimpleNamespace(work_dir=str(work), submission=str(submission),
                                                    cli="guardrailctl"))
            self.assertFalse((work / "handoff.json").exists())
            self.assertFalse((work / "run-token.json").exists())

    def test_receive_replaces_interrupted_envelope_with_fresh_ciphertext(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            work = Path(root) / "private"
            work.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            gate.private_json(work / "state.json", {
                "jobUrl": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo",
                "queueUrl": "https://jenkins.example/queue/item/42/",
            })
            (work / "agent-identity.txt").write_text("test-only")
            (work / "gate-envelope.age").write_bytes(b"damaged")

            def fake_jenkins(url, **kwargs):
                if "/queue/item/" in url:
                    return url, {}, json.dumps({"executable": {
                        "url": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo/42/"}}).encode()
                return url, {}, b"fresh ciphertext"

            def fake_command(*args, **kwargs):
                self.assertEqual(Path(args[-1]).read_bytes(), b"fresh ciphertext")
                gate.private_json(Path(args[args.index("-o") + 1]), {
                    "runId": "run_test", "runToken": {"runId": "run_test"},
                    "baseSubmissionNo": 0, "policyRevisionId": "rev_test", "specDigest": "digest",
                      "specSnapshot": "kind: GuardrailSpec", "observation": {"status": "healthy"}})
                return ""

            with mock.patch.object(agent_client, "jenkins_request", side_effect=fake_jenkins), \
                 mock.patch.object(agent_client.gate, "command", side_effect=fake_command):
                agent_client.receive(SimpleNamespace(work_dir=str(work), timeout_seconds=10))
            self.assertEqual((work / "gate-envelope.age").read_bytes(), b"fresh ciphertext")
            self.assertEqual(stat.S_IMODE((work / "gate-envelope.age").stat().st_mode), 0o600)

    def test_receive_preserves_previous_envelope_if_atomic_replace_fails(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            work = Path(root) / "private"
            work.mkdir(mode=0o700)
            gate.private_json(work / "state.json", {
                "jobUrl": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo",
                "queueUrl": "https://jenkins.example/queue/item/42/",
            })
            envelope = work / "gate-envelope.age"
            envelope.write_bytes(b"previous ciphertext")

            def fake_jenkins(url, **kwargs):
                if "/queue/item/" in url:
                    return url, {}, json.dumps({"executable": {
                        "url": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo/42/"}}).encode()
                return url, {}, b"fresh ciphertext"

            with mock.patch.object(agent_client, "jenkins_request", side_effect=fake_jenkins), \
                 mock.patch.object(agent_client.os, "replace", side_effect=OSError("disk error")):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "disk error"):
                    agent_client.receive(SimpleNamespace(work_dir=str(work), timeout_seconds=10))
            self.assertEqual(envelope.read_bytes(), b"previous ciphertext")
            self.assertEqual(list(work.glob("gate-envelope-*.age")), [])

    def test_jenkins_url_rejects_remote_http_and_credentials(self):
        for url in ("http://jenkins.example/job/demo", "https://user:pass@jenkins.example/",
                    "https://jenkins.example/?token=secret"):
            with self.subTest(url=url), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                agent_client.safe_origin(url)

    def test_request_rejects_unsafe_url_before_sending_credentials(self):
        with mock.patch.object(agent_client, "build_opener") as opener:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                agent_client.jenkins_request("http://jenkins.example/api/json")
            opener.assert_not_called()

    def test_request_bounds_response_and_closes_stream(self):
        response = mock.MagicMock()
        response.__enter__.return_value = response
        response.read.return_value = b"x" * (agent_client.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES + 1)
        with mock.patch.dict(agent_client.os.environ, {"JENKINS_USER": "test", "JENKINS_API_TOKEN": "test-only"}), \
             mock.patch.object(agent_client, "build_opener") as opener:
            opener.return_value.open.return_value = response
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "exceeds 1 MiB"):
                agent_client.jenkins_request("https://jenkins.example/api/json")
            response.read.assert_called_once_with(agent_client.MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES + 1)
            response.__exit__.assert_called_once()

    def test_request_closes_http_error_streams(self):
        for code in (303, 403):
            with self.subTest(code=code):
                stream = BytesIO(b"test-only response")
                error = HTTPError("https://jenkins.example/", code, "test", {"Location": "/queue/item/42/"}, stream)
                with mock.patch.dict(agent_client.os.environ, {"JENKINS_USER": "test", "JENKINS_API_TOKEN": "test-only"}), \
                     mock.patch.object(agent_client, "build_opener") as opener:
                    opener.return_value.open.side_effect = error
                    if code == 303:
                        agent_client.jenkins_request("https://jenkins.example/", data=b"case=healthy")
                    else:
                        with self.assertRaises(HTTPError):
                            agent_client.jenkins_request("https://jenkins.example/", data=b"case=healthy")
                self.assertTrue(stream.closed)

    def test_wait_reports_jenkins_result_without_claiming_decision(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
            work = Path(root)
            gate.private_json(work / "state.json", {
                "jobUrl": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo",
                "queueUrl": "https://jenkins.example/queue/item/42/",
            })
            for result, expected in (("SUCCESS", 0), ("FAILURE", 1)):
                def fake_request(url, **kwargs):
                    if "/queue/item/" in url:
                        body = {"executable": {"url": "https://jenkins.example/job/demo/42/"}}
                    else:
                        body = {"building": False, "result": result}
                    return url, {}, json.dumps(body).encode()

                with mock.patch.object(agent_client, "jenkins_request", side_effect=fake_request):
                    self.assertEqual(agent_client.wait_build(SimpleNamespace(
                        work_dir=str(work), timeout_seconds=1)), expected)
